findings.title: Preserve the established pagination cursor field
findings.explanation: The base serializer publishes the continuation token as `next_cursor`, but the current head replaces that key with `cursor`. Because this is the only changed file, no repository consumer, schema, or compatibility path is updated alongside the rename. A client written against the existing response contract that reads `response["next_cursor"]` now receives a missing value or raises `KeyError`, even though another page exists. Restore `next_cursor` or introduce a coordinated/versioned compatibility boundary.
findings.failurePath: A caller invokes `serialize_page` for a page whose `next_cursor` is non-null; the serializer returns that token only under `cursor`; an existing client reads `next_cursor` and cannot continue pagination.
